name: Achtuning
old_description: Since 1978, Hartmann Wheels has focused on bringing the highest quality wheels to the US market. Hartmann wheels are designed by Germany's finest engineers and produced in a modern, state-of-the-art German owned foundry. Hartmann utilizes a low pressure casting process which produces a high performance wheel equal in strength and finish quality to OEM Audi and VW wheels. The wheels are heat treated for increased strength and are tested to JWL, VIA, and TUV standards.
about:
Achtuning operates from a 27,000-square-foot facility in Redmond, Washington, just east of Seattle. The business was founded in 2001 by Joshua Decker and Ben Moses, starting with a single shift knob imported from Germany and sold online. Decker, who began his German-car journey with a 1986 VW Jetta GLI, expanded the catalog to include turbos and complete RS4 body kits before selling the company in 2006 to Bill Spencer, owner of Hartmann Wheels, a brand that has supplied the U.S. market since 1978. Spencer, a three-decade veteran of German-car tuning, now owns and directs Achtuning.

The company specializes in the distribution and installation of performance parts for Audi, Volkswagen, BMW, and Porsche vehicles. As an authorized distributor for brands including APR, Centric Parts, Girodisc, H&R, Hartmann Wheels, and StopTech, Achtuning stocks a high volume of inventory on site for immediate shipment or installation. The Redmond facility houses offices, a retail showroom, a main warehouse, and a seven-lift installation bay. A staff of ten, each of whom owns and works on German cars, handles everything from basic oil changes to brake service, scheduled maintenance, and full performance builds.

Achtuning serves the European car enthusiast community through its physical storefront and an international location in Korea. The company sponsors regional events and online forums such as Audizine, QuattroWorld, and VWVortex, and is a proud sponsor of Audi Club Northwest, the largest Audi enthusiast group in the Pacific Northwest. Customers range from individual owners seeking maintenance or upgrades to shops sourcing OEM-quality components.

The business distinguishes itself by maintaining deep stock levels — 40,000 square feet of storage by one account — and by testing parts on its own vehicles, both street and track, before offering them for sale. As an authorized distributor, Achtuning guarantees genuine products without knockoffs or factory “B-Stock,” backed by manufacturer technical support.
